title: Stress: Coping Strategies & Management
summary: Coping: Lazarus's primary and secondary appraisal, problem-focused vs emotion-focused coping, and stress-management techniques.
objectives: Describe Lazarus's primary and secondary appraisal.
revision: Coping: Lazarus's primary/secondary appraisal, problem-focused vs emotion-focused coping, stress-management techniques.
traps: Primary appraisal: is this stressful? Secondary appraisal: what can I do?

notes.t: Evaluating whether an event is irrelevant, benign-positive or stressful (threat/challenge/harm).
Evaluating what can be done — available coping resources and options.
Acting directly on the stressor: planning, problem-solving, seeking instrumental support.
Regulating the emotional response: relaxation, reframing, acceptance, seeking emotional support.
Effective coping matches strategy to controllability: problem-focused for controllable stressors, emotion-focused for uncontrollable ones.

i: Relaxation training (progressive muscle relaxation, deep breathing)

notes.t: UGC NET frequently asks about Lazarus's appraisal model and problem- vs emotion-focused coping.

mnemonics.title: APSR
mnemonics.text: A — Appraisal (primary, secondary), P — Problem-focused, S — Stress management, R — Reappraisal/reframing

flashcards.a: Is this event irrelevant, benign-positive or stressful?
